webhook_url.help: Alertmanager webhook URL from the receiver. Often contains a token, so it is stored encrypted.

profile.label: Receiver profile
profile.help: generic, grafana_irm, squadcast, zenduty or keep.

receiver_name.label: Receiver name
receiver_name.help: Sent as the payload's receiver field.

hmac_secret.label: HMAC signing secret
hmac_secret.help: Optional. Adds X-McHarbor-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex> for custom gateways.

allow_http.label: Allow plain http
allow_http.help: Only for a receiver on a trusted private network, such as self-hosted Keep.

test_sends_alert.label: Test connection sends a test alert
test_sends_alert.help: When on, Test fires and immediately resolves an info alert named McHarborConnectionTest.

webhook_url.label: Receiver URL
webhook_url.help: The Alertmanager webhook URL your on-call tool gives you. Stored encrypted because it usually contains a token.

receiver_name.label: Receiver name
receiver_name.help: Sent as the payload's receiver field.

hmac_secret.label: HMAC signing secret
hmac_secret.help: Adds X-McHarbor-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of t.body> for gateways that verify it.

allow_http.label: Allow plain http (trusted private network only)

update_on_repeat.label: Re-send firing on repeat
update_on_repeat.help: When an alert fires again while it is open, send the same alert again, as Alertmanager does on its repeat interval.

test_sends_alert.label: Test connection sends a test alert
test_sends_alert.help: Fires and immediately resolves an info alert named McHarborConnectionTest. Off by default because it can page.

severity_map.label: Severity map (JSON)
severity_map.help: Optional. Renames the severity label values critical, warning and info for receivers configured on other values.

form.secretKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the stored value.
form.insecureWarning: Alerts and credentials travel unencrypted. Use this only for a receiver on a trusted private network.

errors.https: Use an https URL, or turn on plain http for a private receiver.
errors.trailingSlash: Grafana IRM integration URLs end in /.

generic.label: Generic Alertmanager receiver
generic.hint: Sends standard Alertmanager webhook v4 payloads, one group per McHarbor condition.

grafana_irm.label: Grafana Cloud IRM / Grafana OnCall
grafana_irm.hint: Groups by groupKey and auto-resolves on resolved. The URL must keep its trailing slash.

squadcast.label: Squadcast (SolarWinds Incident Response)
squadcast.hint: Always sends labels.severity, annotations.summary and annotations.description, which Squadcast requires.

zenduty.label: Zenduty (Xurrent IMR)
zenduty.hint: Zenduty groups by alertname, so McHarbor appends a short condition ID to keep conditions apart.

keep.label: Keep
keep.hint: Uses Basic auth with username api_key and your Keep API key as the password.

general.oneWay: <warn>This channel is one-way</warn>: McHarbor opens and resolves alerts at the receiver, but acknowledgements made there do not flow back. Use a dedicated PagerDuty, incident.io, Rootly, Splunk On-Call or xMatters channel when you need that.
general.profile: Choose the profile that matches your tool, paste its URL, and save.
general.test: Test connection checks DNS, reachability and TLS without sending anything, unless you turn on Test connection sends a test alert.

grafana_irm.create: In Grafana Cloud, open IRM (OnCall) → Integrations → New integration and choose Alertmanager Prometheus.
grafana_irm.copy: Copy the OnCall Integration URL from the HTTP Endpoint section, including the trailing slash, into Receiver URL.
grafana_irm.templates: Keep the default grouping and autoresolution templates; they match McHarbor's one-group-per-condition payloads.

squadcast.create: In Squadcast, open Services → your service → Alert Sources → Add, choose Prometheus, and copy the Webhook URL into Receiver URL.
squadcast.resolve: Recoveries in McHarbor resolve the Squadcast incident automatically.

zenduty.create: In Zenduty (Xurrent IMR), open your team's service → Integrations → Add Integration, choose Prometheus, and copy the webhook URL into Receiver URL.
zenduty.grouping: Zenduty groups by alertname; the Zenduty profile appends a short condition ID so two containers never share an incident.

keep.create: In Keep, create an API key, set Receiver URL to /alerts/event/prometheus, and choose Basic auth with username api_key.
keep.private: If Keep runs on your private network over http, turn on Allow plain http.
